title: Deputy Manager - Warehouse Equipment & Automation (AWE)
description:
* Warehouse Equipment Solution Design – Primary Focus (Approx. 60%)
* Design and develop storage solutions including selective pallet racking, drive-in / drive-through racking, pallet shuttle racking, mobile racking, cantilever racking, shelving, multi-tier shelving and mezzanine solutions.
* Prepare warehouse layouts, storage capacity calculations, equipment configurations and space-utilization studies considering pallet data, material flow, handling equipment, safety clearances and customer operations.
* Prepare technical specifications, bills of material, load data and design inputs; coordinate structural, seismic and statutory requirements with internal teams, suppliers and engineering partners.
* Review supplier drawings, calculations and offers for technical compliance, scope completeness and cost competitiveness.
* Automation Solution Development (Approx. 40%)
* Support concept development for ASRS, pallet and miniload systems, automated shuttle systems, conveyors, AMR / AGV solutions and integrated material-handling systems.
* Perform basic storage, throughput, equipment-sizing and material-flow calculations and define system interfaces at concept stage.
* Coordinate with automation suppliers, controls / software teams and regional or global experts to develop complete and viable solutions.
* Sales and Presales Support
* Work closely with the sales team throughout the opportunity cycle, from lead qualification and requirement gathering to solution presentation, technical clarification and order handover.
* Participate in customer meetings, site surveys, solution workshops, technical presentations, tender discussions and negotiations.
* Translate customer operational requirements into optimized concepts and clearly communicate solution benefits, assumptions, exclusions and value proposition.
* Support business-development activities, exhibitions, consultant interactions and customer visits as required.
* Costing, Proposal and Documentation
* Prepare concept layouts, BOQ / BOM, cost estimates, technical descriptions, compliance statements and techno-commercial proposal inputs.
* Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and coordinate with purchasing, sales and other stakeholders for competitive pricing and timely proposal submission.
* Maintain proposal accuracy, revision control and documentation of design assumptions, scope boundaries and technical risks.
* Project Handover, Installation and Site Support
* Ensure structured handover of awarded projects to project execution, including approved layouts, design basis, scope, BOM, specifications, assumptions, interfaces and open points.
* Conduct pre-installation site assessments and verify site conditions, access, floor / building readiness, interfaces and installation prerequisites.
* Provide on-site technical support during installation, resolve design-related queries, verify layout and equipment positioning, and coordinate with customers, contractors, suppliers and internal teams.
* Participate in design reviews, inspections, commissioning, snag resolution, acceptance and preparation / review of as-built documentation where required.
* Ensure that the installed solution is consistent with the approved design intent, safety requirements and contractual scope.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Collaborate with Sales, Project Management, Procurement, Service, Finance, EHS, suppliers and regional / global engineering teams.
* Proactively identify technical and commercial risks and escalate deviations that may affect cost, timeline, performance, quality or safety.

title: Manager – Lead Automation & Integration
description:
* Pre-Sales Support & Solution Engineering
* Support customer discussions and translate requirements into practical controls, software, and integration scopes.
* Prepare budgetary and detailed estimates covering PLCs, panels, field devices, safety systems, industrial networks, HMI/SCADA, software interfaces, engineering, testing, and commissioning.
* Review supplier proposals for technical completeness, compliance, exclusions, interfaces, and risks.
* Define supply boundaries and support solution architecture, controls philosophy, interface concepts, scope documents, and technical proposal inputs.
* Supplier Identification & Technical Evaluation
* Develop and maintain a capable supplier network for PLC and controls engineering, WCS/WES, conveyor and ASRS controls, AGV/AMR integration, HMI/SCADA, and industrial networking.
* Assess supplier competence, capacity, references, standards, documentation, service capability, and commercial competitiveness.
* Conduct technical bid comparisons, support negotiations, and establish reusable cost benchmarks and estimation templates.
* Controls & Software Integration Engineering
* Define and review controls and integration architecture, including PLC hardware, I/O, industrial networks, communication protocols, HMI concepts, and safety interfaces.
* Coordinate interfaces among ERP, WMS, WES, WCS, PLC systems, ASRS equipment, conveyors, cranes, shuttle systems, sortation, AGVs/AMRs, and peripheral equipment.
* Review FDS, interface specifications, I/O lists, electrical drawings, and supplier software design documents.
* Support interface mapping, data-point definition, exception handling, test-case preparation, and end-to-end validation.
* Project Execution & Implementation
* Act as technical owner for controls, software, and system integration during project execution.
* Monitor engineering deliverables, interface milestones, approvals, testing plans, supplier actions, risks, deviations, change requests, and open points.
* Coordinate with customer IT/OT teams, equipment suppliers, software partners, global stakeholders, project managers, and site teams.
* Lead or support design reviews, FAT, interface testing, SAT, commissioning, ramp-up, performance testing, and handover.
* Ensure completeness of final documentation, source-code handover requirements, backups, licences, manuals, test records, and training deliverables.
* Localization & Capability Development
* Develop standard controls concepts, specifications, checklists, architectures, and BOMs for AWE projects in India.
* Support standardization of PLCs, drives, safety devices, sensors, panels, networking components, and field hardware.
* Drive localization, value engineering, cost optimization, make-or-buy assessments, and lessons learned for future projects.

title: Presales Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Urban AdMark is a founder-led performance marketing partner focused on real estate and high-ticket brands. The company designs acquisition systems that turn paid traffic into qualified conversations, site visits, bookings, and measurable revenue, rather than vanity leads. Its work spans Meta and Google, supported by conversion-driven landing pages, performance creative, tracking, qualification workflows, and CRM-aligned measurement. Urban AdMark specializes in real estate developers, channel partners, serious sole sellers, high-ticket businesses, and established ecommerce brands, emphasizing bookings, commercial outcomes, and sustainable acquisition economics. The team is intentionally selective, partnering only with businesses that have strong offers, realistic budgets, and the capacity to follow up effectively.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Presales Specialist role based in Kalyan Dombivli. The Presales Specialist will support the sales and client success teams by qualifying inbound and outbound leads, conducting discovery calls, and understanding client needs in real estate and high-ticket sectors. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing presales materials, creating tailored proposals and decks, collaborating with performance marketing specialists to shape acquisition solutions, and ensuring that prospects move smoothly from initial contact to booked consultations or demos. The role involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, tracking qualification metrics, and providing timely, clear communication to both prospects and internal stakeholders. The Presales Specialist will also collect feedback from the market, help refine positioning and offerings, and contribute to revenue-focused pipeline growth.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to assess lead quality, interpret campaign and funnel data, and support data-driven recommendations.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication, active listening, and the ability to explain complex concepts simply.
* Candidates should possess Consulting skills to understand client contexts, ask structured discovery questions, and align Urban AdMark’s solutions with commercial realities.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to deliver responsive, courteous, and solution-oriented support throughout the presales journey.
* Candidates should possess solid Presales skills, including experience with qualification frameworks, proposal creation, and collaboration with sales and marketing teams.
* Familiarity with digital marketing, performance advertising, or real estate sales processes is highly beneficial.
* Proficiency with CRM tools and basic spreadsheet or reporting software is preferred.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is desirable.
* Ability to work on-site in Kalyan Dombivli, manage multiple leads and tasks, and maintain a structured, outcome-focused workflow.
